Official Schedules of Federal Debt / GAO Note 4 inflation adjustment included in accrued interest on Federal Debt Held by the Public. This is accrual-counted-in-expense, not principal-only. Complete monthly Q1 series was not retrieved, so the official fiscal-year annual amount is assigned to the CY row as a proxy and flagged.

Proxy = official SFD Note 2 year-end FRN principal (579.292bn) times official average interest rate (0.400%). Direct instrument-level monthly interest-expense API source was identified but not retrievable in this environment; this is not a direct expense extract.

Proxy = official SFD Note 2 nonmarketable public principal (427.435bn) times official nonmarketable average rate (1.300%). Includes savings securities, SLGS, domestic/foreign/other nonmarketables, and public GAS/G-Fund because SFD classifies those GAS securities as Federal Debt Held by the Public. Official checked tables support principal mix but not a direct savings/SLGS/GAS/other interest-expense split.

Residual construction: MTS Public Issues total 400.223000 minus TIPS inflation compensation 82.754000 minus FRN proxy 2.317168 minus nonmarketable public issue proxy 5.556655. This row is the model-comparable fixed-coupon/bill perimeter only to the extent the component proxies are accepted.

Components are forced to close to the project MTS Public Issues total by the marketable fixed-coupon-plus-bills residual. A nonzero value here would represent an explicit closure error/gap after rounding.
